title: Cocartesian straightening and enlargement of the object universe
statement:
Fix Grothendieck universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal U'\in\mathcal U''$ and use quasicategories, coherent functors, functor equivalences and mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and cocartesian fibrations of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations]. For $\mathcal W=\mathcal U,\mathcal U'$, use the infinity categories $\operatorname{Cat}_{\infty,\mathcal W}$, $\operatorname{coCart}_{\mathcal W}(S)$ and straightening equivalences $\operatorname{St}^{\mathcal W}_S$ of [lem-coef-cocartesian-straightening], with $\mathcal W$ as the object universe; form all displayed categories in $\mathcal U''$. Let $S$ be a $\mathcal U$-small quasicategory. Viewing a $\mathcal U$-small quasicategory in $\mathcal U'$ induces a fully faithful coherent functor $J:\operatorname{Cat}_{\infty,\mathcal U}\to\operatorname{Cat}_{\infty,\mathcal U'}$ sending each quasicategory and each functor to itself. Likewise let $I_S:\operatorname{coCart}_{\mathcal U}(S)\to\operatorname{coCart}_{\mathcal U'}(S)$ view the same simplicial cocartesian fibration and its edge-preserving maps in the larger universe. There is a coherent natural equivalence of functors
$$\operatorname{St}^{\mathcal U'}_S\circ I_S\simeq\operatorname{Fun}(S,J)\circ\operatorname{St}^{\mathcal U}_S,$$
where $\operatorname{Fun}(S,J)$ is postcomposition by $J$. This includes empty bases and empty fibers.
